entities.name: Heart of Yavimaya
entities.description: The eldest and largest magnigoth tree, central to the Yavimaya Forest on Dominaria, a sacred site five thousand feet tall.

entities.name: Yavimaya Forest
entities.description: The forest on Dominaria that formed around the Heart of Yavimaya.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where the Heart of Yavimaya stands.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: The spirit of Yavimaya, who defended the forest and gifted the Weatherseed to Urza.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: A figure whose World Spell ended the Ice Age.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A planeswalker who received the Weatherseed from Multani.

entities.name: Weatherseed
entities.description: A piece of the Heart's core from which grew the hull of Urza's Skyship Weatherlight.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: Urza's great skyship whose hull grew from the Weatherseed.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders who battled the forest's defenders at the Heart.

entities.name: Sylex Blast
entities.description: The event in whose wake the Heart grew.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria
entities.description: The invasion in 4205 AR in which the Heart became a battlefield.

events.summary: The Heart of Yavimaya grows near the Yavimaya River after the Sylex Blast, slowly forming the forest around it.
events.quote: The Heart of Yavimaya grew near the pre-existing Yavimaya River in the wake of the Sylex Blast

events.summary: After Freyalise's World Spell, Multani awakens in darkness and uses the Heart's vines to drive off or kill sentient life.
events.quote: Multani , the spirit of Yavimaya, awoke in darkness and used the Heart's vines to kill sentient life

events.summary: Kaysa, Laina, Jaeuhl Carthalion, Jaya Ballard, Fyndhorn elves and gorilla shamans cleanse the Heart of its darkness.
events.quote: cleansed the Heart of Yavimaya of its darkness

events.summary: In 3357 AR Multani excises the Weatherseed and gifts it to Urza; the Weatherlight's hull grows from it.
events.quote: Multani excised a piece of the tree's core, called the Weatherseed

events.summary: During the Phyrexian Invasion the Heart is badly wounded, but Multani saves it and turns dead Phyrexians into wood elementals.
events.quote: but Multani saved it, turning the dead Phyrexians into wood elementals

relations.quote: the central magnigoth tree of the Yavimaya Forest on Dominaria
